name: Bloody Good Friends
source:
[b]Bloody Good Friends[/b] is a touching visual novel about Mirian, who's only desire is to spend time with her friends during class. What's the worst that could happen?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2633180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[b]《Bloody Good Friends》[/b] 是一部关于Mirian的感人视觉小说，她唯一的愿望就是在课堂上与朋友们共度时光。可能发生的最坏情况是什么？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2633180/]Steam[/url]]
